name: cron
description: Register a SQL query to run on a six-field cron schedule (second / minute / hour / day-of-month / month / day-of-week). Returns a job_id you can use later to inspect or cancel.

name: cron_jobs
description: Table function listing every scheduled job — query, schedule, next-run timestamp, last-run timestamp, and last-run result. The introspection primitive.

name: cron_delete
description: Cancel a scheduled job by its job_id (returned from `cron(...)` or visible in `cron_jobs()`).
